title: Money Concept
definition: Money is any item or verifiable record that is generally accepted as payment for goods and services and repayment of debts in a given socio-economic context or country. It serves simultaneously as a medium of exchange, a unit of account, a store of value, and a standard of deferred payment.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for both Prelims (monetary aggregates, legal tender, cryptocurrency, CBDC) and Mains GS-3 (monetary policy transmission, financial inclusion, digital economy, inflation control).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts, evolutionary stages, and core functions of money.
Evaluate classification of money supplies (M1, M2, M3, M4) and liquidity dynamics.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on monetary economics.
